question_text: The Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion (TRAIN) Law, signed in 2017, restructured the Philippine tax system to make it simpler and fairer. It lowered personal income tax rates for most taxpayers while expanding the value-added tax (VAT) base and increasing excise taxes on fuel, sugar-sweetened beverages, and automobiles. The law also raised the threshold for VAT exemption on gross sales from ₱1.9 million to ₱3 million. Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?

options.text: The TRAIN Law increased taxes on all goods and services.
The TRAIN Law reduced the tax burden for all Filipinos.
The TRAIN Law likely increased government revenue from excise taxes.
The TRAIN Law eliminated the VAT exemption for small businesses.
